Together, we are changing how packaging is designed, sourced and managed â for more efficiency, more sustainability and more impact. Backed by strong investors and driven by an ambitious team, we are growing fast â and we are looking for people who want to shape that growth with us.

\n

  • Recognition and commitment. We believe in fair pay, and you get a clear path to grow and develop with us.


Your tasks

What you bring

  • You are our market expert. You know the Danish market inside out, you are based in or around Copenhagen, and you build lasting customer relationships â culturally on point and close to your customers.
